source.responsiveBehavior: Table view on computer, laptop, and tablet; Card view on mobile.
source.extractionBoundary: The page shell is excluded. The full responsive Collection wrapper, descendants, Collection action contracts, and required page dependencies are included.
cleanup: Removed a stale empty page onLoad formAction from the source page because it is not part of the Collection component contract.
Removed an orphan otheraction reference from the source Delete action; generated Delete remains confirmation-gated and list-bounded.
source.cardViewSource: Collection_control_grid_table (new) mobile Card view subtree; captured through the live MCP component readback

usageContract.materializationRule: Clone grid_table_col_wrapper and all descendants. Do not recreate the component as a legacy Flex Grid table or a static card list.
usageContract.hostRule: Place only inside an approved Dashboard page business-content slot.
editableRegions: native tablecols labels, sortable fields, and repeated item controls
usageContract.lockedRule: Preserve native responsive settings and the full Table view plus Card view trees; Card view lives in grid_table_col_body.children.
usageContract.displayOnlyMode: For Form Report or Data Report sources, omit caption write controls and item operation menus; do not emit edit/delete actions.
usageContract.proofBoundary: Export-proven and configuration-visible responsive behavior only. Verify an installed generated page at desktop/tablet/mobile before claiming runtime proof.

validationContract.nativeTableColumnRule: Every column has title, sortingEnabled, sortingField when sortable, and repeated item content.
validationContract.mobileOperationWidthRule: grid_table_col_operations and op_normal must preserve style.widthtype = [null, \"2\", \"2\"] so mobile controls are Full width.
validationContract.cardViewRule: grid_table_col_body.children must contain the export-shaped mobile Card view item tree; it cannot be empty.
